Author: Nexai
Name: FCCH
Description: Free Company Chest Helper. Automate deposits, withdrawals, and organization. Manage crystals, custom lists, and workshop projects.
Punchline: You ain't savin these slots, you puttin em to work.
Changelog:
- New: Compact item names (optional), item context menu (optional), toolbar customization
- UI: inline per-row buttons on Custom, Ignore, and Workshop tabs
- Lifecycle hardening (shutdown order, disposal ownership, hook teardown) + /fcch ipctest diagnostic
- Additive IPC at contract v3 (CanAcceptCommand, GetBlockReason)
- GetBlockReason now emits chest-closed and unavailable tokens in addition to busy
